accent.job: The one primary action, and a correct answer, always with the check mark and the word Doğru.

light.note: English Prep's own CSS aurora (.ambient in css/editorial.css): one opacity on the parent flattens all nine layers; each source sits at its cluster's rest centre in % of the viewport, sized max(72vw, 470px) × max(78vh, 520px). The light theme lowers the cap to 0.09. Paused when hidden; reduced motion shows three still pools; forced colours hide it.

motion.note: press: the release is the spring (kit motion.md §2). English Prep presses the inner face to 0.945 in 120 ms (cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.25,1)) and releases in a 380 ms keyframe 0.945 → 1.035 → 1 (peak at 48 %), not a spring; that overshoot is why the release sits under press and not under settle. The press spring here peaks and rests when the release does (estimated: no spring from rest reaches the keyframe's overshoot). settle, glide and pop are the app's own v0.76 springs (js/interactions.js SPRINGS): soft ζ 0.88 for content, lively ζ 0.77 for route slides and dialogs (about 2 % past rest: recorded, not retuned to the kit's zero-bounce glide), bouncy ζ 0.61 for marks and glyphs. The route itself moves 360 ms over 12 px on the ease; the verdict mark takes 560 ms after a 220 ms colour cue. Reduced motion and the Profil toggle make every spatial move instant.
